description: This file contains implementation of TPS (Throttle Position Sensor) related functions and variables for sensor readings, state management, and configuration, primarily used in engine control firmware.

methods.name: setMockTpsPosition
methods.description: Simulates TPS position for unit testing; sets the mock TPS value.

methods.name: setMockPedalPosition
methods.description: Sets the simulated pedal position for testing.

methods.name: saveTpsState
methods.description: Stores TPS state data in a lock-free thread-safe manner, tracking rate of change.

methods.name: getTpsRateOfChange
methods.description: Returns the current rate of change of TPS.

methods.name: getTpsValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current TPS position based on ADC reading.

methods.name: getTPSVoltage
methods.description: Returns the voltage reading from the TPS sensor.

methods.name: getTPS12bitAdc
methods.description: Gets the ADC value from the TPS sensor, using mock values if in test mode.

methods.name: getPrimatyRawTPS
methods.description: Returns the raw TPS percentage value based on ADC.

methods.name: hasPedalPositionSensor
methods.description: Checks if a pedal position sensor is configured.

methods.name: getPedalPosition
methods.description: Returns the pedal position as a percentage, interpolated from voltage.

methods.name: hasTpsSensor
methods.description: Checks if a TPS sensor is configured.

methods.name: getTPS
methods.description: Returns the current TPS value or a special magic value if no sensor.

methods.name: setBosch0280750009
methods.description: Configures TPS calibration parameters for a specific vehicle setup.

methods.name: convertVoltageTo10bitADC
methods.description: Converts a voltage value into a 10-bit ADC reading considering voltage divider effects.
